data.name: v2.25.1
data.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release addresses the security vulnerability [PSA-2026-4QX1WG](https://gadvisory.org/advisories/PSA-2026-4QX1WG), all users are recommended to upgrade immediately.

## What's Changed
* docs(security): a role address for time-critical reports instead of a personal one by @egelhaus in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2195
* fix(settings): hide the Teams tab from the User role by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2200
* feat(tags): expose tag editing in the tags dropdown by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/1828
* fix(tags): readable calendar tag labels on any tag color by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/1829
* feat(calendar): open-post link icon that resolves the release URL on click by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2194
* fix(calendar): surface curated provider errors in the calendar, public API and MCP by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2119
* fix(billing): persist cancelAt on cancel/reactivate instead of waiting for the webhook by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2112
* fix(frontend): skip the Sentry report dialog for errors from browser extensions by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2165
* feat(channels): rename a channel in Postiz while keeping its original name by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2190
* docs(claude): code invoked by external webhooks must not throw by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2202
* feat(subscription): re-enable disabled channels when the new plan can hold all of them by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2160
* fix: guard against duplicate Stripe subscriptions per customer by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2061
* feat: show login method in Global Settings by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2203
* fix(calendar): make the post delete icon and confirmation red, swap Delete and Preview by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2204
* fix(posts): find-slot never responds when all channels are disabled by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2207
* feat(calendar): channel multi-select filter above the calendar by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2205
* feat(calendar): frame published posts in green with a checkmark by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2206
* fix(permissions): look up the refreshed channel by internalId in the channel limit check by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2208
* feat: auto text direction (RTL) in composer editor and previews by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2209
* feat(sponsors): re-add chatbotx to readme by @egelhaus in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2210
* fix(instagram): map the Trial Reel publish limit error to a readable message by @giladresisi in https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app/pull/2215
